hotspots.title: La Libertad Avanza internal power struggles
hotspots.blurb: Argentina's ruling party faces escalating internal conflicts, particularly between factions led by Santiago Caputo and Martín Menem, with President Javier Milei caught in the middle. The dispute involves allegations of fabricated scandals and delayed asset declarations by key officials like Manuel Adorni.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot commands attention due to its high affective investment, with polarized contention, moral panic over corruption allegations, and a leadership crisis tone dominating coverage.
